definitions.explanation: The hard outer covering of eggs, nuts, or shellfish.
The outer covering of grains or seeds.

examples.english: It broke through the shell and came out.

examples.english: The husks are removed from the wheat before it is ground into flour.

notes:
{殻|から} refers to the hard outer covering of eggs, nuts, shellfish, or seeds.

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧の{殻|から}: eggshell
- ⟦{貝殻|かいがら}→貝殻：19457_kaigara⟧: seashell
- ⟦{木|き}の{実|み}→木の実：13018_kinomi⟧の{殻|から}: nutshell
- ⟦{籾殻|もみがら}→籾殻：28136_momigara⟧: rice husk/chaff

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {殻|から}を⟦{剥|む}く→剥く：02305_muku⟧: to peel off a shell
- {殻|から}を⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧: to break through a shell
- {殻|から}を⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to crack a shell

FIGURATIVE USE:
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧の{殻|から}を⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ means to break out of one's shell (overcome shyness or limitations).

RELATED:
- ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧: skin, peel (softer covering)
- ⟦{甲羅|こうら}→甲羅：21848_koura⟧: shell (of turtles, crabs)
